title: Electrical contacts to two-dimensional semiconductors
key_contributions: Extensive compilation of experimental Schottky barrier heights for Ti, Mo, Ni, Au, Pt, and Sc on MoS2
Quantitative measurement of Fermi-level pinning factor (S ~ 0.1) across deposited metals
Decomposition of tunneling vs thermionic barrier resistances

title: Ultralow contact resistance between semimetal and monolayer semiconductors
key_contributions: Semimetallic Bi (0001) vdW contact demonstration with ultralow Rc ~ 123 Ohm*um
Benchmark comparison table of state-of-the-art contact resistances in monolayer MoS2 across literature
Zero Schottky barrier height verification via low-temperature Arrhenius activation

title: Approaching the Schottky-Mott limit in van der Waals metal-semiconductor junctions
key_contributions: Systematic comparison of transferred vdW contacts vs conventional evaporated contacts
Restoration of Schottky-Mott slope (S ~ 0.96) for transferred metal contacts
Extensive tabulated Schottky barrier heights for Ag, In, Cu, Au, Pt, and Ti on MoS2

title: Contact engineering for 2D materials and devices
key_contributions: Meta-analysis of 1T metallic phase engineering, graphene interlayers, chemical doping, and hBN encapsulation
Tabulation of contact resistances reported with transmission line measurements (TLM)
Standardization of Rc normalization by contact width (Ohm*um)

title: Phase-engineered low-resistance contacts to monolayer 2D semiconductors
key_contributions: 2H to 1T local phase transition achieving Rc ~ 200-300 Ohm*um
Detailed TLM resistance versus channel length extraction data

title: Contact resistance benchmarks and scaling limits in monolayer MoS2 FETs
key_contributions: Rigorous ultra-high vacuum TLM measurements on monolayer MoS2
Rc extraction under high carrier densities (n > 10^13 cm^-2)
Demonstration of Au-only and Ti/Au contacts down to Rc ~ 740 Ohm*um
